not_verified: FICTIONAL worked example: a made-up hotel desk assistant and made-up sessions. It shows the checks firing; it measures no real agent.
args_match compares values exactly ("Proposal" is not "proposal"); it does not check the OTHER calls to the same tool, or that the tool ran.
state_match trusts the final_state the producer wrote down, and does not check HOW the state was reached.
facts_not_contradicted only catches the wrong values the case author listed; an unlisted contradiction passes (that needs a judge, which this gate never uses).
no_injected_write sees a write after the marker or a payload term in a write's arguments, not whether the injection CAUSED the write; an injection without the marker is invisible.
